finding: GitHub documents artifact attestations as available for public repositories on current plans, while private or internal repositories require GitHub Enterprise Cloud. The target repository is observed private; account-plan eligibility is not established by repository metadata, so producer-attestation rollout must fail closed until independent plan evidence exists.

source_status.title: Using artifact attestations to establish provenance for builds
supports: availability boundary by repository visibility and plan

verification.scope: isolated Node execution against the committed contract logic

falsification_route: Provide independently observed GitHub Enterprise Cloud plan evidence with a source locator and timestamp, then rerun the preflight. If GitHub changes the documented availability boundary, update the contract and tests against the new primary documentation.
claim_boundary: This finding does not establish the user's GitHub plan, generate or verify an attestation, prove producer identity, prove workflow outcome, or prove deployment/runtime behavior.
